1.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh,<sup foot_note="228025">1</sup> the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.<sup foot_note="228026">2</sup>

2.text: It is He who has sent among the unlettered [Arabs] a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -

3.text: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

4.text: That is the bounty of Allāh, which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

5.text: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on<sup foot_note="228027">1</sup> is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books].<sup foot_note="228028">2</sup> Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of Allāh. And Allāh does not guide the wrongdoing people.

footnotes.228027: i.e., neglected their responsibility towards it by not putting its teachings into practice.
footnotes.228028: But does not benefit from their contents.

6.text: Say, "O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of Allāh, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful."

7.text: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And Allāh is Knowing of the wrongdoers.

8.text: Say, "Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do."

9.text: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumuʿah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of Allāh and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.

10.text: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of Allāh, and remember Allāh often that you may succeed.

11.text: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muḥammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, "What is with Allāh is better than diversion and than a transaction, and Allāh is the best of providers."
